question: What packages do you offer?
answer: Three tiers: Seed (up to 5 pages, 7–14 days), Rise (up to 8 pages, 14–21 days, 1 month free maintenance), and Summit (up to 15 pages, 21–30 days, 3 months free maintenance). All packages include design, development, hosting setup, and SSL. Projects start from GHS 2,500 and each package is quoted to scope.

question: How much does a website cost?
answer: Projects start from GHS 2,500. Past that we quote to scope, because a five-page site and a fifteen-page platform are not the same job. Individual services (design, development, hosting, maintenance) are also available standalone. Verified NGOs and nonprofits receive a 20 percent partnership rate.

question: How long does it take to build my website?
answer: Delivery timelines depend on the package - 7–14 days for Seed, 14–21 days for Rise, and 21–30 days for Summit. We also send a full proposal within 48 hours of your discovery call. All timelines start from the date we receive your content and full brief.

question: Do you offer a discount for NGOs, nonprofits, or startups?
answer: Yes. KoomBei extends a 20 percent partnership rate to verified NGOs and nonprofits, a commitment we have kept since the studio was founded. Share your organisation's registration number in the discovery form and we confirm it in your proposal.

question: How do I get started?
answer: It takes three steps: fill out our discovery form on the Contact page (about 5 minutes), we review your brief and send a tailored proposal within 48 hours, then we agree on scope and begin building. Head to the Contact page to kick things off.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Mobile Money (MoMo and AirtelTigo) and bank transfer. We work with a deposit before starting and the balance on delivery. All payment details are confirmed in writing before any work begins.

question: Who hosts the website and do I need to manage it?
answer: Hosting setup is included in every package. We deploy on Vercel, connect your custom domain, configure DNS and SSL, and manage the setup for 12 months. You do not need technical knowledge to manage it - we handle all of that, and we are available if anything ever needs adjusting.

question: What happens after my website launches?
answer: After launch you receive post-launch support: 2 weeks on Seed, 1 month on Rise, 3 months on Summit, covering bug fixes and minor changes. After that, maintenance runs on a monthly retainer or per update, quoted to what you need. We walk with you long after launch day.
